name: All Metal Brake
tagline: Independent backup power reviews and buying guides
llmsIntro: Independent backup power buying guides: home, portable, inverter and dual fuel generators, portable power stations, home batteries, solar generators, transfer switches, surge protectors, UPS units and outage gear. Every product has a spec sheet, a research-based AMB Score (0–100) and a verdict. Products are researched against spec sheets, manuals, independent measurements and owner reports; they were not bench-tested by us.
